text:
Rosa's episode 3 of The Glass Atlas (released 2026-11-19) is the one (episode, follower) pair that can't be watched in time. Every other episode is covered, for 7 paid periods costing $81.00.

**Starting situation (limit: 2 non-required services at once)**
- Lumen is already paid through Nov 28, Kestrel+ through Nov 9 and Northline through Nov 13.
- Nov 1–9: three services already have access, which is over the limit, so no new period may give access.
- Nov 10–13: Lumen and Northline fill both slots.
- Nov 14–28: only Lumen is on, so one slot is free.

**Why one pair must be missed**
- The Silver Orchard (Tom, 7 episodes on Tidewell) needs Tidewell on a day from Nov 5 to Nov 19. Because of the blocked days, Tidewell must start between Nov 14 and Nov 19.
- Rosa's Glass Atlas episode 3 needs Northline on a day from Nov 19 to Nov 26.
- Only one slot is free in that stretch, and a period lasts a month. So only one of the two services can be added.
- Missing episode 3 costs 1 pair, while dropping The Silver Orchard would cost 7. So Tidewell gets the slot.

**Plan**
- **Tidewell from Nov 14** (access through Dec 13): covers The Silver Orchard.
- **Northline from Nov 29** (the day Lumen's paid access ends) and **from Dec 29**: continuous access Nov 29 to Jan 28. This covers Glass Atlas episodes 4–12, whose windows run Nov 26 to Jan 28. Episodes 1–2 are covered by the already-paid access.
- **Lumen from Dec 15, Jan 15 and Feb 15**: covers all 11 Paper Lantern windows, Dec 15 to Mar 2.
  - Three periods are needed. The first must start by Dec 22, so two periods would end by Feb 21. That misses the last window, which starts Feb 23.
- **Tidewell from Jan 29**, after Northline ends: covers Velvet Garden for Tom and Rosa (available Dec 29 to Feb 8).

**Limit check**
| Dates | Services with access |
|---|---|
| Nov 14–28 | Lumen, Tidewell |
| Nov 29–Dec 13 | Northline, Tidewell |
| Dec 15–Jan 28 | Lumen, Northline |
| Jan 29 onward | Lumen, Tidewell |

No day has more than 2. Each service needs the minimum number of periods for its windows, so the cost can't be lower without missing more pairs.

**Cost**
| Service | Periods | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Tidewell | 2 × $8.99 | $17.98 |
| Northline | 2 × $11.99 | $23.98 |
| Lumen | 3 × $15.49 | $46.47 |
| **Total** | | **$88.43** |

Correction: the total above is $88.43, not $81.00 as stated in the first line.
